aliases: Warrenton DC Owner 1 LLC data center
status_detail: Warrenton Board of Aldermen approved conditional use permit and site plan on Jan. 20, 2026; city later approved a 75% personal property tax abatement/leasing/funding agreement in April 2026. Further permits/reviews still needed before construction.
notes: Reported site is 22151 NW Service Road on roughly 336-340 acres, with two approximately 805,000 sq ft data center buildings plus a 40,000 sq ft administration building. Third-party trackers claim 450 MW per building / 900 MW total, but official/news capacity was not disclosed, so capacity_mw left null.

project_name: Marshfield Rifle Range Road high-performance computing facility
status_detail: Webster County Commission said the project is a small-scale high-performance computing facility on a five-acre site outside Marshfield on Rifle Range Road; June 16 county statement says the county is aware of the data center development currently under construction and does not intend to halt that project with the six-month moratorium.
notes: Official details: roughly 70x200 building, closed-loop cooling, residential-style well around 500 ft deep / 20 gpm capacity, no tax abatement or economic development incentives requested. DCD/KY3 identify developer as Lumon Solutions and describe it as Tier III / AI-ready.
